plugins.name: qoq
plugins.description: Quality toolkit for JavaScript/TypeScript repos — `fix`, `refactor`, `bump`, `plan`, `replan`, `execute`, `test`, `compress`, `document`, `mermaid`, `sheriff`, `review`. Use it whenever the user wants lint or formatting cleaned up, dead code or dead dependencies removed, a branch checked before merge, duplication refactored, npm dependencies bumped or known vulnerabilities in them fixed, a spec broken into tickets, an existing plan reshaped or re-decomposed after it stalled or the requirements moved, an approved plan executed or resumed — from a plan file or a Jira, Linear or Trello milestone — tests written for code that already exists, or agent-facing markdown (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skill docs) made terser to stop burning context, the why behind code written down as JSDoc and `./docs` for the next session or person, a flow, lifecycle, data model or architecture drawn as a Mermaid diagram that renders on GitHub, or a change or a path checked for security problems a linter can't see — injection, missing auth checks, leaked secrets, unsafe input, or a delivered change or pull request checked against its plan or description for wrong turns, scope creep or inconsistency between tickets. Trigger it even when the user never says "qoq" or names a tool.
